summary: FlashDrop multi-file iteration tested end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (multi-file upload, single-file backwards compat, >20 files rejection, invalid expiry/max_downloads, file info with files array, ZIP download for multi, direct stream for single, individual file download, counter increments, auto-cleanup at max_downloads, delete). Frontend: multi-file selection, per-file remove, add-more-files-btn, 'Generate PIN · 2 files' label, bundle-summary '2 files', PIN result, receive via ?pin= query auto-loads, file list with per-file Get + 'Download all' primary button, single-file bundle shows only 'Download file' (no list, no zip), invalid PIN 000000 shows 'File not found or expired' via receive-error.

minor.issue: When file_id is invalid, _claim_download still increments download_count before the 404 lookup happens. A malformed file_id wastes a download slot.
Uses asyncio.create_task from a sync BackgroundTask; works under uvicorn but fragile. Already noted in iter 1.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Look up file_id existence BEFORE _claim_download in /api/download/{pin}/{file_id} so bad ids don’t consume a download.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py download_single calls _claim_download() first, then checks if file_id exists in bundle – an invalid file_id still consumes a download. Validate file_id BEFORE incrementing counter.
_cleanup_bundle_sync schedules asyncio.create_task from sync code via BackgroundTasks; will raise RuntimeError if executed outside running loop. Convert to async cleanup task.
No rate-limit / auth on /api/upload – disk-fill risk (acceptable for MVP, document).
ZIP is built fully on disk then streamed (Content-Length set, file unlinked after stream). Fine for 700MB ceiling, but consider streaming-ZIP for memory at higher caps.
seed_data_creation: Transient bundles created and cleaned via DELETE /api/file/{pin} in pytest; two tmp txts in /tmp/fdtest for UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Updated test file /app/backend/tests/test_flashdrop.py now uses multi-file schema (key 'files'). Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_flashdrop.py. Frontend testids verified: file-input (hidden, use state='attached'), selected-file-item-{idx}, remove-file-btn-{idx}, add-more-files-btn, generate-pin-btn (label 'Generate PIN · N files' for multi, just 'Generate PIN' for single), bundle-summary, received-bundle-card, received-file-row-{file_id}, download-single-btn-{file_id}, download-file-btn (‘Download all as ZIP’ for multi / ‘Download file’ for single), pin-input-field, receive-error, pin-display-text.
